correctness.rationale: The two separate complete enumerators traversed all 3^15=14,348,907 states and agree on all 26 nonzero joint entry-time/primitive-period cells and 1/3/4/7 period counts. Peeling a functional digraph by indegree and reversing the deleted order correctly reconstructs least periods and first entry times. The independent forward-path algorithm reaches the identical table. Every one of 270 long-period cycle representatives and its image under all 720 graph automorphisms was checked; the S6 group equality also has an elementary maximal-independent-star proof. The maximum ten-step entry is attained 1440 times. All code and outputs are embedded; no unbounded mathematical claim is made.

value.rationale: KG(6,2) is a canonical first triangle-containing graph in the two-subset Kneser sequence; the exact orbit census is a natural benchmark for finite excitable media rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The longest primitive period seven has a single full S6 symmetry type (180 cycles), whereas period four has two 45-cycle types with distinct excitation profiles. An exact 10-step settling cutoff and 26-cell full census reveal structure and sharp limitations of the model that graph adjacency data and prior activity criteria do not supply. Finite classification is the full mathematical scope, with no paper-sized or infinite generalization claimed.
